releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.5.7 - Exact Daily Activated Metrics & Profile Sync
releaseNotes:
• Exact Daily Activated Voucher Accounting: Stocked inventory vouchers are strictly excluded; only genuine active/activated vouchers in the selected date window are counted
• Harmonized Profile Sales & Revenue: Total revenue and per-profile sales strictly reflect activated voucher sales amounts
• Clean Data Consumption Display: Profile and modal metrics clearly display Data Used (ဒေတာ သုံးစွဲမှု) with pure usage accounting
• Profile Sum Synchronized Data Total: Overall dashboard data usage strictly equals the exact sum of all profile consumptions
• Date-Filtered Profile Inspection Modal: Tap any profile to view only the vouchers activated within the selected date window
• Multi-Device & Reboot Resilience: Persistent router metadata ensures identical metrics across all phones and after router reboots
